sources.name: Town of Nederland - Community Events page
sources.notes: Read 6 October 2026. A static page under Community > Explore Nederland > Events listing the Town's recurring annual events without dates: Nederland Farmer's Market (every other Sunday, May to October), Town Cleanup Day (first Saturday in June), Ned Gravel bike race, Carousel of Happiness Summer Circus at Chipeta Park, Ned Jazz & Wine Festival (Nederland Area Seniors), Ned*Ned half marathon through old town, and the Holiday Mountain Market craft fair. It points organisers to the Special Event & Public Rental page (/1214/Public-Space-Rentals, linked, not fetched). The Explore Nederland hub (/1441/Explore-Nederland) also links /1442/Events (not fetched), /1434/Nederland-Visitors-Center, /1444/History and /1446/Trails-Open-Spaces. No feed; a seasonal checklist for the editor rather than a weekly source. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).

sources.name: Town of Nederland calendar (nederlandco.org)
sources.notes: Read 6 October 2026. nederlandco.org is a CivicPlus (CivicEngage) site titled 'Nederland, CO | Official Website'; www.nederlandco.gov serves the same site (a guessed /community-center path returned the CivicPlus custom 404 there). Calendar.aspx offers only three calendars: Federal Holidays, Public Space Rentals and Town Board Meetings. October 2026 shows six items, all under Town Board Meetings: Board of Trustees 6 and 20 Oct 7-10 pm, Downtown Development Authority 14 Oct 6-8 pm, Parks, Recreation & Open Space Advisory Board 15 Oct 5:30-7 pm, Sustainability Advisory Board 22 Oct 7-10 pm (Multipurpose Room of the Nederland Community Center) and Planning Commission 28 Oct 6-9 pm; every location is 750 Highway 72 North, Nederland CO 80466. The home-page widget said 'There are no published events in current month'. The CivicPlus calendar RSS (feedUrl) failed with a connection error on the first attempt and read successfully on the retry: 3 items (Board of Trustees Meeting, Downtown Development Authority, Parks Recreation & Open Space Advisory Board Meeting), pubDates 18 Aug 2026 -0700, structured event dates and the 750 Highway 72 North location. The CivicPlus iCalendar endpoint with catID=14 (/common/modules/iCalendar/iCalendar.aspx?catID=14&feed=calendar) returned the Federal Holidays calendar: 47 VEVENT, 2 RRULE, 2024-11-03 to 2035-11-11, TZ America/Denver, with CivicPlus placeholder locations 'Manhattan KS 66502'; other catIDs were not probed. So the Town feed is essentially civic meetings and holidays; it is useful for the meetings section and as a Community Center venue reference, not for community events. The Town's older Colorado.gov site (townofnederland.colorado.gov/explore-nederland/event-calendar) still ranks in search but answered CloudFront 403 'Request blocked' on 6 October. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).

sources.name: Boulder County events (bouldercounty.gov)
sources.notes: The HTML events page (bouldercounty.gov/events/) was not fetched in this pass, so url is the feed itself. Feed read once on 6 October 2026 (the same The Events Calendar feed Niwot and Lyons already use): 30 VEVENT, 0 RRULE, DTSTARTs from 2025-03-09 to 2027-11-07 (one stale item, the rest upcoming). Sample titles: 'No commissioners' hearings or meetings are scheduled this week', County Commissioners' Business Meeting (Hybrid), Get Strategic About Your Job Search, Las Barracas Tour, Election Champion Workshop, Niwot Local Improvement District Advisory Committee Meeting, Board of Adjustment Public Meeting, Evening at the Museum: Switzerland Trail Railroad, Interview Preparation, AHC Open, Astronomy: The Ringed Giant at Its Best. Sample locations: Commissioners' Hearing Room, 1325 Pearl Street, Boulder; Virtual via Zoom; Near Longmont; Niwot Inn Conference Room; a bare 'CO'; one geo: URI. Mostly county meetings and workforce workshops, with Parks & Open Space museum and nature programmes mixed in; none of the sampled locations named Nederland, so expect few hits for the locationFilter. Search results show an events category for the Nederland Mining Museum at bouldercounty.gov/events/category/parks-open-space/nederland-mining-museum (not fetched) which may be a better filter than a location string. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).

sources.name: Town of Nederland parks, trails and Community Center
sources.notes: Read 6 October 2026. The Town has no separate recreation department site; parks and trails within Town limits are maintained by Public Works under the Parks, Recreation and Open Space Advisory Board (PROSAB, which meets at the Community Center, 15 Oct per the calendar). The page lists Angel Park (620 W Spruce St), Barker Meadows Reservoir (East St and Boulder Canyon Dr: parking, picnic, fishing, trails), Chipeta Park (254 Lakeview Dr: shelter, play equipment, children's pond), Flarty Park, Guercio Memorial Park (ball field, East St by Barker Reservoir), Joe Smith Park (Upper Sundown Trail), Mud Lake Open Space (2034 County Road 126, listed here though it is Boulder County open space), Nathan Lazarus Skatepark (155 East 1st St) and NedRink ice rink and tennis courts (500 Indian Peaks Dr, truncated in the fetch). The Nederland Community Center at 750 Highway 72 North hosts every Town board meeting; a dedicated Community Center page was not found (www.nederlandco.gov/community-center 404). Public Space Rentals is at /1214/Public-Space-Rentals (linked, not fetched). No feed. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).

sources.name: USDA Forest Service - Arapaho & Roosevelt NF, Boulder Ranger District alerts
sources.notes: Read 6 October 2026. Land agency filed under parks. The forest alerts index (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/alerts; the older https://www.fs.usda.gov/alerts/arp/alerts-notices serves the same page) lists every current order for the Arapaho and Roosevelt National Forests and Pawnee National Grassland with a fire-danger status per district (Boulder Ranger District: Moderate on 6 Oct). Boulder-district items seen: Brainard Lake Recreation Area (/r02/arp/alerts/brainard-lake-recreation-area, a standing 'Prohibitions within Brainard Lake Recreation Area' order 10-01-2013-01 from 29 March 2013, end date N/A, not the seasonal timed-entry notice), Indian Peaks Wilderness Restrictions (/r02/arp/alerts/indian-peaks-wilderness-restrictions), Caribou Road closure order (NFSR 505.1, unsafe road conditions), a raptor nesting area closure on the Boulder Ranger District, and forest-wide fire restrictions. The district offices page (/r02/arp/offices) is linked but was not fetched, and the Brainard Lake recreation-area page, its summer timed-entry reservations (recreation.gov) and the winter gate closure were not verified in this pass. Plain HTML, no RSS or iCal; link the alerts index and the Brainard alert. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).
